# Pass only eligible notifications to the display manager

A July 2024 bug showed updateNotifications passed the raw cache to NotificationManager, bypassing date and interaction filtering. All manager updates now go through _updateNotificationManager and its getNotifications result. The regression test uses a future high-priority item and a current lower-priority item to prove the future item stays hidden.

Scope: in-app notification filtering.

Paths:

- `mail/components/inappnotifications/modules/InAppNotifications.sys.mjs`

## Evidence

[Shared lesson record](../records/8fad843ed7c07ca691d48a3cff7f3506255d8cf974ab0249c6b04c425ab91e07.json).

this.notificationManager.updatedNotifications(this.getNotifications());
~~~

## Validation and limits

Status: **supported**. This backfill preserves earlier findings and their uncertainty. It does not count unstudied commits as complete. Historical test outcomes remain reported outcomes. No runtime tests or builds were rerun for publication.

Supporting source excerpts and references are included in the shared records.
